Reproducing the figures and numbers of the manuscript

Verifying more is not enough when false positives track the environmental gradient in occupancy models

This document redraws Figures 3 to 7 of the manuscript and recomputes every result that the text reports, from the scored outputs of the scripts in analysis/. Each number is shown as the text gives it next to the value computed here, and the document fails to render if any of them disagree, so that the text and the data cannot drift apart. Figures 1 and 2 are schematic (R/fig_dag_v2.R and manuscript/figures/make_scheme_fig2.py).
